context.description: Die lernende Person kann das Bogenmass als alternative Beschreibung von Winkelgrößen am Einheitskreis veranschaulichen und sicher zwischen Gradmass und Bogenmass wechseln.
context.titleEn: Illustrate radian measure on the unit circle and switch confidently between degrees and radians
context.descriptionEn: The learner can illustrate radian measure as an alternative description of angles on the unit circle and switch confidently between degrees and radians.
context.subject: mathematik

originalReason: Unit radius and quadrant positions 0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2 are correct. The misleading clockwise arrow is removed. 360 degrees equals 2pi radians and degree times pi/180 is correct.
